resolution.note: App krn-works-delivery (id 5696029) created by the lead with the operator's sudo; key and ids in Bitwarden item 'KRN delivery GitHub App'. Four write tests captured in test/fixtures/github-app-token: mint+re-mint after expiry, workflow push refused, ruleset PUT 403, and this PR shipped by krn pr ship under the App credential.

title: Delivery sessions hold a credential that can only propose
body:
Outcome: lead and lane sessions run `git` and `gh` with a GitHub App installation token limited to this repository: contents write, pull requests write, actions write (to re-run a failed job, `src/deliver/gate-wait.ts:138`), checks read, metadata; no workflows, no administration. The token is minted on demand by a git credential helper and a `gh` wrapper, because it expires after one hour; it is not an exported variable. The administrator token stays in the operator's keyring.
Why: every session today can rewrite workflows, rulesets and organization settings (**[R]** V3). This is the one control in section A that rests on exposure alone and needs no incident to justify it. An App is preferred to a fine-grained token because it acts under its own name: it becomes the author of delivery PRs, which A4 needs, and the audit log can tell a lane from the operator [I, to be confirmed by the write tests].
Proof: four write tests with the limited token, each output saved verbatim as a capture (KRN-12): `krn pr ship` end to end including auto-merge; a push that edits a workflow file is refused; `gh api -X PUT` on the ruleset is refused; a token minted after the first has expired works in the same session.
Undo: the launcher falls back to the operator's token behind one flag, set by the operator.
Scope: `scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts`, a minting helper, `docs/program/repository-workflow.md`.
Limit to state in the task: without the sandbox of C1 this protects against a lane that is wrong, not one that is hostile; a session on the host can still ask the keyring for the administrator token. After this slice a commit that edits a workflow file is pushed by the operator's credential; composite actions under `.github/actions/**` are not under the `workflows` permission and stay pushable by the App [I].
Order: A1, A2 and A6 need nobody. A5 needs the operator once. A4 is a choice the operator can decline.
Operator order 2026-11-10: deliver the helper, launcher flag and tests with the App absent; do not create the App or store or mint its key; then give the operator a ten-line instruction (this repository only; contents write, pull requests write, actions write, checks read, metadata; no workflows, no administration).
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice A5.
